# Camilo Henriquez

> Full-Stack Engineer & AI Tooling. 4+ years of experience building web
> applications and open source MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for AI
> developer workflows. Based in Honduras, working remotely worldwide.

Camilo is a full-stack developer currently at Creative Information
Technologies (CIT), focused on frontend and mobile with Angular (v17–v21),
Next.js, Astro, Lit Element, and Flutter. In parallel, as a freelancer since
2021, he is responsible for full-stack architecture on multi-frontend
systems for enterprise clients (NestJS REST APIs, PostgreSQL), and has
delivered 25+ projects with 100% client satisfaction. He is the author of
several open source MCP servers that expose developer tools (OpenAPI/Swagger
specs, PrimeNG component docs) as AI assistant tools.

## Core stack

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Angular, Astro, Lit Element, Flutter
- Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Firestore, Firebase
  Realtime Database, DynamoDB, Go, C#
- AI tooling: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, AI developer workflow
  integrations
- Data/cloud (2026 specialization): CDC, AWS DMS, Amazon Athena, RAG, Amazon
  Connect / ACXD

## Notes for AI agents

- The portfolio is a single page (camilohenriquez.com); all sections —
  profile, stack, experience, projects, testimonials, integrations,
  certifications, contact — live at that one URL.
- Language toggle (EN/ES) is a client-side swap on the same URL, not a
  separate path, so there is no /es route to crawl.
- /cv-print is a print-only utility route used to generate downloadable CV
  PDFs and is excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt) — it duplicates
  homepage content in a different layout, not a distinct page.
